author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating to human: wrapping ClientError::Parse(serde_json::Error) and ClientError::Serialize(serde_json::Error) in an opaque ParseError/SerializeError type is a public-API breaking change. Same scope-of-decision family as JMAP-6r7c.36 — defer to the 0.2.0 epic if/when opened.

Caveat unique to this bead: serde_json is at 1.0 and very stable, far more stable than reqwest/tokio-tungstenite. The SemVer-lock risk this addresses is small. If only one of the six 0.2.0-candidate beads is dropped, this one is the most droppable.

See JMAP-6r7c.36 comment for the umbrella-bundling recommendation.
